nl: Name the three largest files under backups/ (searched recursively), largest first.
oracle_program: find "backups" type: file sort: size order: desc |> first 3 |> select path size
reference_pwsh: Get-ChildItem backups -Recurse -File | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Length) $($_.Name)" }
